definitions.explanation: A person engaged in a specified activity as a paid occupation rather than as an amateur.
Having great skill or experience in a particular field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧プロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He is a professional baseball player.

examples.japanese: プロ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm aiming to become a professional.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧18⟦{歳|さい}→歳：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧プロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ダンサー→ダンサー：08801_dansaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: She became a professional dancer at 18.

examples.japanese: ⟦さすが→流石：00359_sasuga⟧プロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: I was told my cooking skill is on a professional level.

notes:
プロ is short for ⟦プロフェッショナル→プロフェッショナル：26668_purofesshonaru⟧ (professional). Used as both a noun and a な-adjective.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プロ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a professional
- プロ⟦{野球|やきゅう}→野球：04727_yakyuu⟧: professional baseball
- プロ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: professional athlete
- プロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧: professional skill/technique
- プロ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: professional attitude/mindset
- プロ⟦{並|な}み→並み：11374_nami⟧: at a professional level

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プロ: professional (paid occupation)
- ⟦セミプロ→セミプロ：noentry⟧: semi-professional
- ⟦アマチュア→アマチュア：10730_amachua⟧: amateur (hobby level)
- ⟦{素人|しろうと}→素人：04270_shirouto⟧: amateur, layperson (can sound dismissive)

USAGE:
⟦さすが→流石：00359_sasuga⟧プロ⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ ("As expected of a pro") is a common compliment for skilled work.
